verdict: Source-dependent NO-GO endorsed; actual native assay materials found, but no concrete useful unreported case/condition contrast established
substantive_source_evidence: Both genuine public primary methods were independently read with safe whitelist. Counts and design are 15 GRM1 IHC (3 TMA/12 whole),3 previous qPCR controls, and16 older six-marker IHC materials. These are assay/material conditions, not independently authenticated donors or same-case pairing.
prior_art_and_value: The papers explicitly study GRM1 distinction of chondromyxoid fibroma and immunophenotypic discrimination of chordoid meningioma from mimics. Their diagnostic marker comparisons/specificity are already published. Recovered native control assays are useful coverage evidence, not first protein expression or a new diagnostic finding.
useful_addition_test: No public native same-case cross-assay/localization/co-stain condition map supports an experiment-changing unreported contrast beyond authors diagnostic claims. Cross-donor RNA–IHC discrepancy, incomplete localization and marker count summaries cannot establish accessible surface protein, dependency, cycle state or clinical utility.
strongest_alternatives: Single-core sampling versus whole section, tissue compartment/cell selection, fixation/decalcification/antibody and threshold variation.
Unresolved RNA-protein material pairing and unknown shared-archive donor overlap.
Ordinal/per-marker aggregates conceal covariance and individual co-occurrence, so no new classifier or combination specificity can be reconstructed.
Author/pathology cohort labels lack independently established per-case molecular identity in permitted source-method fields; no generic subtype transfer.
unfavorable_and_inconclusive: All native condition groups and controls remain visible, source4-mm unit ambiguity retained, five CMF recurrence pairs not reassigned to EMC. Suitable actual individual assay maps remain pending, not proven absent.
exposure: Owner accidental published table-cell exposure disclosed; this reviewer did not inspect outcomes. No fully blinded campaign claim or numerical proposal.
coverage: All185 bibliographic records hash/identity frame verified, only two selected method bodies evaluated; incomplete185 body coverage explicit and suitable pending blocks promotion.
reopening: Actual source-linked authentic native EMC case/condition/compartment/donor map and public measured counterpart controls supporting a genuinely useful unanswered contrast beyond published diagnostic performance; clear assay units, preparation/selection/replicate/missingness, disclosure of exposure and root-reviewed prospective design before new outcomes.
